svg.text: Probity Architecture — Prevention, Detection, Correction loops
Mapping the instruments across an integrity cycle (with statutory citers)

g.text: PREVENTION (upstream)
• Codes — AIS 1968 · CCS 1964 conduct rules
• Ethics training — LBSNAA modules ("2nd ARC")
• Conflict-of-interest disclosures · gift norms
• Citizen charters → Sevottam service standards
• GeM + CPPP (e-procurement) · Integrity Pacts/IEM
• Social audit pipelines (MGNREGA → AP model)
• Whistle-blower protection (WBP Act 2014)
• Open data + Sec 4 RTI proactive disclosure
Moral of band: system design removes temptation pathways.
Tools anchor: Nolan-7 values + 2nd ARC ethics-in-gov chapters.
Quality signals: ISO-certified services; faceless assessment (IT)
reduces contact-based corruption; DBT plumbing works upstream.
Budget hooks: GFR 2017, procurement manuals, VGF/PPP discipline.
DETECTION & INVESTIGATION
• Audit — CAG (constitutional; PAC downstream)
• CVC supervision over departmental vigilance (CVOs)
• CBI — DSPE-derived; fixed tenure (Vineet Narain)
• ED — PMLA tail-enforcement of predicate offences
• Lokpal & Lokayuktas Act 2013 (civic complainant)
• Internal: IB-led surprise checks; e-audit trails
• Fast-follow via IT Act + I4C for cyber-fraud syndicates
• Forensic audit ecosystems (SFIO, banks' early-warning sig.)
Reforms tension: s17A prior-approval shields vs proactive hunt.
Balance saved through judicial oversight (quash/transfer options).
Constraint: capacity (vacancies, forensic staff) & state consent
for CBI — general consent withdrawal churn (multistate cases).
Track note: ED conviction-rate debates highlight process quality.
CORRECTION & ACCOUNTABILITY
• Prosecution & courts (PC Act penalties post-BNS/BNSS 2023)
• Departmental discipline — CCA rules; promotion bars
• Asset recovery — PMLA attachment; shell-company strike-offs
• Service-level compensation (MP Lok Sewa / Sakala-style penalties)
• Systemic redress — CPGRAMS closure metrics + Sevottam re-certs
• Reform learning — post-scam GFR tweaks, GeM category reviews
• Public messaging — transparency reports (CVC annual, audit news)
defeat lessons-learned: integrity dashboards; outcome metrics
Equity guard: justice to least-advantaged insured via compensation
clauses and exception-desks in DBT/pension flows.
Most-overlooked: closure-reports quality ("treated-as-closed" loops
in CPGRAMS) — auditors should re-sample citizen confirmations.
KPI north-star: public trust indices, not merely conviction counts.

svg.text: Loop logic: prevention failures become detection loads; detection feeds correction; correction experiences re-engineer prevention.
